basic_details.short_information: Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kollam, established by the Government of Kerala, has invited applications from eligible candidates for appointment to the post of Assistant (on contract) in the University. The appointment is made on a contract basis in accordance with the provisions of the Sreenarayanaguru Open University Act and Statutes and other orders applicable to the University from time to time. Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official recruitment portal by 11/11/2026.

how_to_apply: Access the University recruitment portal at https://sgou.ac.in/.
Fill in all particulars in the online application form.
Upload legible copies of the required documents, including certificates in support of age, qualifications, ID proof, experience, and other claims along with the application.
Submit the application online through the portal within the prescribed time.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Assistant (on contract) at a Glance

rows.details: Not more than 40 years as on 01/01/2026 (with usual relaxation for SC/ST and OBC as per Government of Kerala Rules)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy all prescribed eligibility conditions, including age, educational qualifications, and experience. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply, and reservation benefits are available only to eligible natives of Kerala. Educational Qualification: A Degree in any Faculty from a recognised University or its equivalent, and proficiency in Computer & IT Applications including Data Entry/ Office Automation Tools. Desirable Experience: Experience in Open & Distant Mode of Education in Universities / Recognized Higher Education Institutions. Age Limit: Not more than 40 years as on 01/01/2026. Upper age-limit relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD is applicable only in accordance with the rules/orders of the Government of Kerala in force.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment to the post of Assistant shall be on a contract basis for the period specified by the University. Renewal/extension, if any, shall depend on the requirements of the University, satisfactory performance, and the decision of the competent authority. Such appointment shall not confer any right or claim for regular appointment or permanent absorption in the University. The consolidated contract pay is Rs. 34,180/- per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGOU Assistant (on contract)
content_sections.text: Access the University recruitment portal at https://sgou.ac.in/ . Fill in all particulars in the online application form. Upload legible copies of the required documents, including certificates in support of age, qualifications, ID proof, experience, and other claims along with the application. Submit the application online through the portal within the prescribed time.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee of the University. The University may shortlist candidates based on qualifications, skill test, interview, or any combination thereof. Short-listed candidates will be called for an interview, and appointment will be subject to verification of original documents and satisfactory antecedents.

rows.event: Last Date for Online Submission of Applications

faq.question: Q1. Is the SGOU Assistant post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment to the post of Assistant is made purely on a contract basis for the period specified by the University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 40 years of age as on 01/01/2026. Upper age-limit relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD in accordance with the rules and orders of the Government of Kerala in force.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: The University may shortlist candidates based on qualifications, skill test, interview, or any combination thereof, before calling them for an interview.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Degree in any Faculty from a recognised University or its equivalent, along with proficiency in Computer & IT Applications including Data Entry/ Office Automation Tools.
